description: The departement table (data/france_conventions_v1.json) evaluated for every day. "departements": one representative point per departement (inside its outline), year 2026. "cities": city centres, years 2026, 2027 and 2028. minutes[prayer] is a list with one value per day starting 1 January (Isha before 06:00 is +1440). Expected values from the study 4 harness.
